prompt: Create ONE unique transparent PNG illustration for this LeetCode problem using attached images as strict character and style references. Sparse flat 2D sketch: slightly irregular teal outlines, round cream heads, dot eyes, thin limbs, simple geometric bodies. Female has teal ponytail and curved forelock, peach shirt; male has short teal tuft, mustard shirt. Same duo proportions and faces across poses, with scene-appropriate accessories. Cream/peach/mustard/mint and occasional blue. One LONG SHALLOW horizontal scene about6:1; use small waist-up busts at ends with large relevant objects across width. Keep artwork in central band of tall canvas for trimming; empty space above/below/between objects must be genuine alpha transparency. NO white/gray background, checkerboard, panel, halo, glow, shadows, stray pixels, speech balloons, scenery or3D. All figures safely within margins, opaque interiors. Minimal exact text only when specified. Illustrate task premise, not solution algorithm. Strong strokes legible in light and dark UI. Scene: 3169 Count Days Without Meetings. One horizontal five-day calendar strip labeled1,2,3,4,5. Days1,2,4 have peach meeting marks, days3 and5 mint with tiny clear sun symbols. Above cells1-2 a small peach meeting ribbon; above4 another single-cell ribbon. Female with calendar clipboard points at free day3, male holds small cream badge2 for two days free. Exactly five days, no date sorting algorithm or extra labels.
